_note: formal-v2 (2026-10-21, user decisions): train <= 10000, test <= 1000 (fewer when the source has fewer). Train keeps the official train split's own distribution (no matching to the test mix); MuSiQue without the per-paragraph cap; QASPER train takes every question of the train + validation papers; CWQ draws train from the official RoG train only, test from the official test, and its corpus is the union of the subgraphs of all three splits. MultiHop (user, 2026-10-21): no official split -> test = 500 questions drawn at random stratified by question type (source mix, <= 3 per identical evidence set); train = every other question except those with an evidence-fact set identical to a test question's (~1,680).
